segments.text: To be successful here, you need to have a crazy work ethic.
We're looking for people that really want to level up in life.
You know, this isn't the easiest job.
There's a lot of easier jobs, but this is a very fulfilling job
that if you put in the time, you put in the work,
then eventually you can get to the next level of life.
And we're looking for guys that have no glass ceiling,
guys that just want to constantly grow and grow and grow.
Because once you master one position,
we have another position for you available,
and after that, we have another one.
So we're looking for guys that want careers,
that want long-term wealth and long-term health.
